content: Previous studies on the summarization tasks have only used entities in the preprocessing stage to anonymize the dataset BIBREF15 and to mitigate out-of-vocabulary problems BIBREF14 . Linked entities for summarization are still not properly explored and we are the first to use linked entities to improve the performance of the summarizer.
